questiontext.text:
Nairobi Commute Lab

Each dot represents one commuter. Drag the dots horizontally. Your challenge is to make the range as large as possible, while keeping the mean commute at {@target@} minutes. Each journey must be between 0 and 60 minutes.

Watch the histogram change as you move the dots. The bars show how many commuters fall in each ten-minute interval.

[[jsxgraph width="100%" aspect-ratio="2/1" input-ref-ans1="answerId"]] var N = {#n#}, TARGET = {#target#}, MAXRANGE = {#rmax#}; var field = document.getElementById(answerId); // Begin with a modest spread (within +/-5 minutes), preserving the target mean. var offsets = [-5,5,-3,3,-1,1,-4,4,-2,2]; var values = offsets.slice(0,N).map(function(d){return TARGET+d;}); // Shuffle the starting positions so the pattern is less predictable. for (var z=values.length-1;z>0;z--) { var j=Math.floor(Math.random()*(z+1)); var tmp=values[z];values[z]=values[j];values[j]=tmp; } try { var old = JSON.parse(field.value); if (Array.isArray(old) && old.length === N && old.every(function(v){return Number.isInteger(v) && v>=0 && v<=60;})) values = old; } catch(e) {} var board = JXG.JSXGraph.initBoard(divid, { boundingbox:[-5,10,65,-1], axis:false, showCopyright:false, showNavigation:false, keepaspectratio:false }); board.suspendUpdate(); for (var k=0;k<=60;k+=10) { board.create('segment',[[k,0],[k,9.1]],{strokeColor:'#dddddd',strokeWidth:1,fixed:true}); board.create('text',[k,-0.55,String(k)],{fontSize:11,fixed:true,anchorX:'middle'}); } board.create('segment',[[0,0],[60,0]],{strokeColor:'#555',fixed:true}); board.create('segment',[[0,5.1],[60,5.1]],{strokeColor:'#555',fixed:true}); board.create('text',[0,9.65,'COMMUTERS (drag horizontally)'],{fontSize:13,fixed:true}); board.create('text',[0,4.65,'LIVE HISTOGRAM'],{fontSize:13,fixed:true}); var bars=[]; for(var b=0;b<6;b++){ var x0=b*10+0.4, x1=(b+1)*10-0.4; var poly=board.create('polygon',[[x0,0],[x1,0],[x1,0.1],[x0,0.1]],{ fillColor:'#0d9488',fillOpacity:0.8,borders:{strokeColor:'#ffffff',strokeWidth:1}, vertices:{visible:false,fixed:true},fixed:true,hasInnerPoints:false }); bars.push(poly); } var pts=[]; var palette=['#2563eb','#0891b2','#7c3aed','#db2777','#16a34a','#ea580c']; function getMean(){return values.reduce(function(a,b){return a+b;},0)/N;} function getRange(){return Math.max.apply(null,values)-Math.min.apply(null,values);} var summary=board.create('text',[0,4.1,function(){ return 'Mean: '+getMean().toFixed(1)+' min (target '+TARGET+') Range: '+getRange()+' min (maximum '+MAXRANGE+')'; }],{fontSize:13,fixed:true}); function redraw(){ var counts=[0,0,0,0,0,0]; values.forEach(function(v){counts[Math.min(5,Math.floor(v/10))]++;}); bars.forEach(function(poly,j){ var h=counts[j]*0.55; poly.vertices[2].moveTo([j*10+9.6,h]); poly.vertices[3].moveTo([j*10+0.4,h]); }); field.value='['+values.join(',')+']'; field.dispatchEvent(new Event('change',{bubbles:true})); board.update(); } for(var i=0;i[[input:ans1]] [[validation:ans1]]

When satisfied, submit your answer.

generalfeedback.text: With {@n@} commuters, a target mean of {@target@} minutes means the total commuting time must be {@n*target@} minutes. Since individual commutes must be between 0 and 60 minutes, the greatest achievable range is {@rmax@} minutes. A smaller mean can limit the greatest possible range: for instance, if the total is less than 60 minutes, no individual commute can reach 60 minutes. The mean can stay fixed while the distribution and range change.

prtcorrect.text: Great work! You have created the required variability.

prtincorrect.text: Keep experimenting with the values and their mean.

feedbackvariables.text: valid: is(listp(ans1) and length(ans1)=n); ok: if valid then is(every(lambda([v],integerp(v) and v>=0 and v<=60),ans1) and sum(ans1[i],i,1,n)=n*target and apply(max,ans1)-apply(min,ans1)=rmax) else false;

truefeedback.text: Success! The overall mean does not tell us how different the observations are.

falsefeedback.text: Not yet. Check both the target mean and the spread, then try again.
